view.title: C2b - Container drill-down: module wiring — module-c overlay
view.caption: This view is a subset of `03-container-module-wiring` opening `APP` — only the edges owned by `module-c`. Edge numbers match the primary; see `03-container-module-wiring` for the complete edge set.

nodes.label: evidence
detail: Evidence (cluster C) - Preserve Provenance + metrics read model + auditor export.
Only MC anchors the lineage chain.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL
detail: WORKING ASSUMPTION (spine C3); dev/CI embedded or containerized, ephemeral-only (D1, M40).

Schemas: conversion-state; lineage (append-only: app role INSERT/SELECT only, per-conversion hash chain, supersede-not-update - ADR 0012); outbox+queue (bounded retries, dead-letter quarantine - M21); judge-response cache (M27, CF7).

nodes.label: object storage
detail: Evidence object storage behind an S3-compatible port (ADR 0011).
Dev/CI: containerized MinIO; production BINDING PROBE-PENDING (week-0 platform probe; default = self-operated MinIO).
Write-once / object-lock REQUIRED - ADR 0012's precondition, deployment-checked.
Holds: classified artifacts + retention classes (M39); canonicalized source snapshots (M15); lineage chain anchors (ADR 0012).
Envelope encryption + crypto-shredding before the first audit-retained artifact (ADR 0011 as amended).

edges.detail: Versioned export; itself an attributable lineage event (CF11)
Chain-head anchors at interval; a stale anchor is an alert (ADR 0012)
